items.source: Values come from parent entities but one might also add values manually.
items.translation: 值来自父实体，但也可以手动添加值。

items.source: The DbAction of a parent entity, possibly the aggregate root.
items.translation: 父实体（可能是聚合根）的DbAction。

items.source: The DbAction of a parent entity, possibly the aggregate root. This is used to obtain values needed to persist the entity, that are not part of the current entity, especially the id of the parent, which might only become available once the parent entity got persisted.
items.translation: 父实体（可能是聚合根）的DbAction接口。该接口用于获取持久化当前实体所需的值，这些值不属于当前实体本身，特别是父实体的 ID，该 ID 可能仅在父实体被持久化后才可用。

items.source: An action depending on another action for providing additional information like the id of a parent entity.
items.translation: 一种依赖于另一个动作以提供额外信息（例如父实体的 ID）的动作。
